raw_intuition: Teoria dos números, conjuntos, primos ou gráficos, só tem o vazio e o zero. O resto é discretização da matemática.
linked_prior_intuition: Pode existir MOD em resolução/base 0,1; bases, módulos e malhas podem ser refinados em pedaços menores coexistentes.

set_theoretic_seed.statement: Em uma construção padrão dos naturais por ordinais de von Neumann, 0 = empty_set e os naturais seguintes podem ser gerados recursivamente a partir dele.
set_theoretic_seed.does_not_imply: Que toda matemática seja literalmente apenas discretização.

multiscale_discretization.example: b=10, q=0.1 gives a decimal lattice whose modular period may be refined to q=0.01, 0.001, ...

number_theory.statement: Integers, divisibility, primes and modular classes are discrete structures once the integer domain is chosen.

graph_theory.statement: Finite graphs admit binary incidence/adjacency encodings, but weighted, probabilistic and continuous graph models also exist.

continuum_boundary.statement: Real/complex analysis and continuous structures are not, in standard mathematics, identified with finite discretizations, even though they may be represented or approximated discretely.

working_conjecture: A large class of mathematical objects can be organized as recursively generated or encoded distinctions emerging from an empty/zero seed, with observed/computational structure expressed through nested discretizations and modular resolutions.
token_vazio: Whether the proposed empty/zero primitive can be made definitionally sufficient for all mathematical domains without importing extra axioms or operations.
Whether continuity should be treated as ontologically primitive, a completion/limit construction, or only as an effective description in this framework.
Exact relation between radix 9, radix 10, q=0.1 and the user's broader geometric MOD construction.
Whether 'vazio e zero' is intended literally as two primitives or as one primitive equivalence empty_set == 0 plus a presence/successor operator.
falsifiers_or_stress_tests: Attempt a precise axiom system and identify the minimum primitives/operators required beyond empty_set/0.
Construct naturals, integers, rationals, reals, primes, sets and finite graphs without silently introducing unregistered primitives.
Compare base-9 and base-10 refinements and test which properties are radix-invariant.
Separate exact continuous objects from finite approximations to prevent discretization from being conflated with equality.
